question: Akatsuki CON-17(b): the PR verify title depends on the repository kind. Reading: a repository whose kind is not declared reads as unknown and the check reports that instead of guessing. Confirm?

options.label: Unknown, reported (Recommended)
options.consequence: Confirm: an undeclared kind is reported as unknown; the check neither passes nor guesses

options.label: Default to process
options.consequence: Amend: an undeclared kind defaults to process and its verify title
